notes.title: Signup for Playtesting NOW!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! It is time to let you all know that you can now sign up for early playtesting of Eternal Damnation! 

The playtest you will be taking part in will take place over a number of weeks and will focus around testing different mechanics, biomes and functionality of the game. You are not obligated to take part in every stage of testing but you will be invited to do so via email as well as discord. All feedback will be submitted via a window within the game itself and we ask that you are as honest and helpful as possible. If this method fails for whatever reason, please feel free to feedback via the ‘#playtest-feedback’ channel in our discord.

How to Partake?
To sign up for playtesting join our discord here and submit your information in this form.

All players signed up to playtest Eternal Damnation will receive our gratitude in a number of ways, consisting of: Exclusive tester in-game content (skins, badges, items), full credit in the game credits, Discord Roles and a 20% discount for Eternal Damnation on Steam and Epic Stores.

Join our Discord below!
